records.text: Candace Owens said she believed chicken feed had been poisoned, questioned whether Perdue was the company involved, and claimed the pharmaceutical industry controls chicken feed.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: There was also a story years ago about how they had poisoned the chicken feed, which I totally believe happened, and all of these hens were not laying. ... when we looked behind the company that was behind it, it was like Perdue, wasn't it? Am I just thinking it's Perdue because it's Perdue chicken? You— I don't know. ... the point is, is that it was Big Pharma, which even controls what the chickens eat.

verification.notes: The transcript accurately preserves Owens's belief and uncertainty, but experts and state feed officials found no evidence of deliberately poisoned feed causing the 2023 egg decline. Perdue is a family-owned food and agriculture company; no evidence supports pharmaceutical-industry control.

sources.title: FACT FOCUS: Egg shortage breeds chicken-feed conspiracies
sources.relevance: Experts and state feed officials report no evidence of deliberately altered or poisoned feed causing the egg-production decline.

sources.title: Company — Perdue Farms
sources.relevance: Official company information identifies Perdue as a family-owned food and agriculture company, not a pharmaceutical company.
